name: Troglodyte
traits: Medium Humanoid (Reptilian). −2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 90 ft. and +6 natural armor.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Sickened creatures take −2 on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.

Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +1, base Fortitude +3, Reflex +0, Will +0, and one feat. Racial skill points are five times (2 + Intelligence modifier), with a minimum of 1 point per Hit Die before the first-Hit-Die multiplier. Hide and Listen are racial class skills.
Draconic is automatic. Bonus languages are Common, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. LA +2, so ECL 4 before class levels. Favored class Cleric.
Underdark lists the advancement entry and refers to the Monster Manual for the playable racial traits.
